# NvVolumetricLighting.d3d11 -- reconstruction of NVIDIA GameWorks Volumetric Lighting (D3D11 backend)
#
# Builds NvVolumetricLighting.d3d11.dll. Like the original, the DLL does not import d3d11.dll/dxgi.dll:
# it receives the ID3D11Device through PlatformDesc and only uses COM interfaces.
# All shader permutations (shaders/Permutations.cmake, generated by tools/shaders.py gen) are
# compiled with fxc at build time and embedded as /Fh byte arrays.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

if (NOT DEFINED PROJECT_NAME)
    project(NvVolumetricLighting LANGUAGES CXX)
endif()

set(NVVL_FXC "C:/Program Files (x86)/Windows Kits/10/bin/10.0.19041.0/x64/fxc.exe" CACHE FILEPATH
    "fxc.exe used to compile the NvVolumetricLighting shaders (the original blobs were built with fxc 10.1)")
if (NOT EXISTS "${NVVL_FXC}")
    find_program(NVVL_FXC_FOUND fxc PATHS "$ENV{WindowsSdkVerBinPath}/x64" "$ENV{WindowsSdkBinPath}/x64")
    if (NVVL_FXC_FOUND)
        set(NVVL_FXC "${NVVL_FXC_FOUND}")
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR "NvVolumetricLighting: fxc.exe not found, set NVVL_FXC")
    endif()
endif()

set(NVVL_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(NVVL_SHADER_DIR ${NVVL_DIR}/shaders)
set(NVVL_GEN_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shader permutations
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
include(${NVVL_SHADER_DIR}/Permutations.cmake)
file(GLOB NVVL_SHADER_INCLUDES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${NVVL_SHADER_DIR}/*.hlsli)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${NVVL_SHADER_DIR}/Permutations.cmake)

set(NVVL_SHADER_HEADERS)
set(NVVL_TABLES_INCLUDES "")
set(NVVL_TABLES_DEFS "")
foreach(fam IN LISTS NVVL_SHADER_FAMILIES)
    set(src ${NVVL_SHADER_DIR}/${NVVL_${fam}_SOURCE})
    set(entries "")
    set(sizes "")
    # index -> variable name map for the table
    foreach(idx IN LISTS NVVL_${fam}_INDICES)
        set(out ${NVVL_GEN_DIR}/${fam}/${fam}_${idx}.h)
        set(defs)
        foreach(d IN LISTS NVVL_${fam}_${idx}_DEFINES)
            list(APPEND defs /D ${d})
        endforeach()
        add_custom_command(
            OUTPUT ${out}
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${NVVL_GEN_DIR}/${fam}
            COMMAND ${NVVL_FXC} /nologo /WX /T ${NVVL_${fam}_PROFILE} /E ${NVVL_${fam}_ENTRY} ${defs}
                    /Vn g_${fam}_${idx} /Fh ${out} ${src}
            DEPENDS ${src} ${NVVL_SHADER_INCLUDES}
            COMMENT "fxc ${fam}[${idx}]"
            VERBATIM)
        list(APPEND NVVL_SHADER_HEADERS ${out})
        string(APPEND NVVL_TABLES_INCLUDES "#include \"${fam}/${fam}_${idx}.h\"\n")
        set(NVVL_HAS_${fam}_${idx} TRUE)
    endforeach()
    math(EXPR last "${NVVL_${fam}_SIZE} - 1")
    foreach(i RANGE 0 ${last})
        if (NVVL_HAS_${fam}_${i})
            string(APPEND entries "    g_${fam}_${i},\n")
            string(APPEND sizes "    sizeof(g_${fam}_${i}),\n")
        else()
            string(APPEND entries "    nullptr,\n")
            string(APPEND sizes "    0,\n")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    string(APPEND NVVL_TABLES_DEFS
        "const void* const ${fam}[${NVVL_${fam}_SIZE}] = {\n${entries}};\n"
        "const uint32_t ${fam}_Size[${NVVL_${fam}_SIZE}] = {\n${sizes}};\n\n")
endforeach()

set(NVVL_TABLES_CPP ${NVVL_GEN_DIR}/CompiledShaders.cpp)
set(NVVL_TABLES_CONTENT
"// Generated by CMakeLists.txt from shaders/Permutations.cmake -- do not edit.
#include <windows.h>
#include \"d3d11/CompiledShaders.h\"

${NVVL_TABLES_INCLUDES}
namespace Nv
{
namespace VolumetricLighting
{
namespace Shaders
{

${NVVL_TABLES_DEFS}} // namespace Shaders
} // namespace VolumetricLighting
} // namespace Nv
")
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT ${NVVL_TABLES_CPP} CONTENT "${NVVL_TABLES_CONTENT}" @ONLY)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Library
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(NVVL_PUBLIC_HEADERS
    include/Nv/VolumetricLighting/NvVolumetricLighting.h
    include/Nv/VolumetricLighting/NvFoundationTypes.h)

set(NVVL_SOURCES
    src/Common.h
    src/NvVolumetricLighting.cpp
    src/VectorMath.h
    src/VectorMath.cpp
    src/ShaderConstants.h
    src/ContextImp.h
    src/ContextImp.cpp
    src/d3d11/CompiledShaders.h
    src/d3d11/ShaderPermutations.h
    src/d3d11/D3D11Util.h
    src/d3d11/D3D11Util.cpp
    src/d3d11/ContextImp_D3D11.h
    src/d3d11/ContextImp_D3D11.cpp)

file(GLOB NVVL_SHADER_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${NVVL_SHADER_DIR}/*.hlsl ${NVVL_SHADER_DIR}/*.hlsli)
set_source_files_properties(${NVVL_SHADER_SOURCES} PROPERTIES HEADER_FILE_ONLY TRUE)

add_library(NvVolumetricLighting.d3d11 SHARED
    ${NVVL_PUBLIC_HEADERS}
    ${NVVL_SOURCES}
    ${NVVL_TABLES_CPP}
    ${NVVL_SHADER_HEADERS}
    ${NVVL_SHADER_SOURCES})

source_group("Shaders" FILES ${NVVL_SHADER_SOURCES})
source_group("Generated" FILES ${NVVL_TABLES_CPP} ${NVVL_SHADER_HEADERS})

target_include_directories(NvVolumetricLighting.d3d11
    PUBLIC ${NVVL_DIR}/include
    PRIVATE ${NVVL_DIR}/src ${NVVL_GEN_DIR})
target_compile_definitions(NvVolumetricLighting.d3d11 PRIVATE
    NV_VOLUMETRICLIGHTING_BUILD_DLL
    WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
    NOMINMAX)
target_compile_features(NvVolumetricLighting.d3d11 PRIVATE cxx_std_14)
if (MSVC)
    # /d2FH4-: use __CxxFrameHandler3 like the original (no VCRUNTIME140_1.dll dependency)
    target_compile_options(NvVolumetricLighting.d3d11 PRIVATE /W3 /bigobj /d2FH4-)
    target_link_options(NvVolumetricLighting.d3d11 PRIVATE /d2:-FH4-)
endif()
set_target_properties(NvVolumetricLighting.d3d11 PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME "NvVolumetricLighting.d3d11"
    FOLDER "NvVolumetricLighting")
# No target_link_libraries: the original imports only the CRT and kernel32.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Smoke test (WARP device; loads either the rebuilt or the original DLL at run time)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
option(NVVL_BUILD_SMOKETEST "Build the NvVolumetricLighting D3D11 smoke test" ON)
if (NVVL_BUILD_SMOKETEST AND EXISTS ${NVVL_DIR}/test/SmokeTest.cpp)
    add_executable(NvVolumetricLighting.smoketest test/SmokeTest.cpp)
    target_include_directories(NvVolumetricLighting.smoketest PRIVATE ${NVVL_DIR}/include)
    target_link_libraries(NvVolumetricLighting.smoketest PRIVATE d3d11 d3dcompiler)
    target_compile_features(NvVolumetricLighting.smoketest PRIVATE cxx_std_14)
    add_dependencies(NvVolumetricLighting.smoketest NvVolumetricLighting.d3d11)
    set_target_properties(NvVolumetricLighting.smoketest PROPERTIES FOLDER "NvVolumetricLighting")
endif()
